Approach:
Create a recursive function and check: 
- if node equals None, return None
- if value < node, call itself with node's left as curr node
- elif value > node, call itself with node's right as curr node
- else node equals value, check for 4 cases:
    - if it has no children, return None
    - elif has only left child, assign curr node as node's left
    - elif has only right child, assign curr node as node's right
    - elif has both children, calculate min value node from curr's 
right. assign that to curr node and delete the min value node
Time & Space Complexity:
Average Case: O(log n)
Worst Case: O(n) [resembles LL 
when tree becomes unbalanced]
Edge Cases:
1. Definition for min value method
Sol. Traverse sub tree to its left and return last node
